save images and attachments locally with the clipped note

disambiguation: Despite the sync-focused name, it is also a clipper that pulls WeChat, Feishu, and web content into the vault.
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; clipping and sync traffic goes through api.wetongbu.com; no client-side telemetry; local clipping works without configuring object storage, but account authorization gates synchronization and some features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to clip content from WeChat, Feishu, or the web into notes, and built-in Sync requires a paid plan or self-configured storage.
